summary: First-iteration testing of Sugar (Expo/RN + FastAPI + MongoDB random-match dating app). Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass covering signup (200/409/400), login (200/401), /auth/me (401), profile verify (200/400 + has_selfie flag), and WebSocket flows (bot fallback ~4s, invalid-token close, stop teardown, real 2-user match + next -> partner_left). Frontend: Login-as-Lisa -> lobby -> Start Dating -> searching -> bot-matched (Amara) -> Next re-searches and re-matches -> Stop returns to lobby all working. Signup -> /verify screen correctly displayed for unverified user. Invalid login shows German error 'Ungültige E-Mail oder Passwort'. One functional bug: signing out from /lobby (and likely /verify) does NOT redirect to /login because AuthContext.signOut only clears state; index.tsx only redirects on visit. User is left on the lobby screen with user=null and a broken 'S' avatar. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping the sign-out button clears token/user in AuthContext but never navigates to /login. User is stranded on the lobby screen with a broken 'S' fallback avatar and 'Start Dating' still visible. Reference: /app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.tsx:57-61 and /app/frontend/app/lobby.tsx:62. Same issue exists on /app/frontend/app/verify.tsx:96 (verify-signout).

issues: iconBtn (signout) is 40x40 which is below the 44x44 touch-target guideline; hitSlop=12 mitigates but consider bumping the visual size to 44.

action_items: Fix sign-out navigation: after signOut() call router.replace('/login') from the lobby and verify screens, OR make signOut itself trigger a redirect (e.g., navigate inside AuthContext), OR add a useEffect in lobby/verify that redirects to /login when token becomes null. Recommended: add `if (!token) return <Redirect href='/login' />` guard at the top of lobby.tsx and verify.tsx (mirroring index.tsx).
Optional: enlarge lobby signout iconBtn visual footprint to 44x44 for accessibility.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.signOut() lacks navigation side-effect; combined with expo-router's non-reactive Redirect (index-only), any authenticated screen becomes stranded post-signout.
No route guards on /lobby, /verify, /stage. Direct navigation to these routes without a valid token would render broken UI (though not reachable in normal flow).
server.py: manager state is in-process only; horizontal scaling of the backend will break matching. Fine for MVP but should be flagged for future.
server.py: BOT_TIMEOUT/BOTS constants and MatchManager are all in server.py (337 lines) — still under the 700-line threshold, so no split needed yet.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_/ui. signup users during runs; they are harmless test rows in the users collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and passes fully. WebSocket real-pair test relies on two fresh signups sending 'find' inside the 4s bot window. If flakiness appears, retry. Frontend signout redirect bug is the only functional issue found; once fixed, retest by logging in as lisa@sugar.app/secret123, tapping lobby-signout, and asserting the app returns to the /login screen with the Sugar logo visible.
rca_of_issue: signout stuck on lobby: AuthContext.signOut() (context/AuthContext.tsx L57-61) only calls storage.secureRemove + setToken(null) + setUser(null). expo-router does not re-run <Redirect> from app/index.tsx unless the user navigates back to '/'. Since the lobby route stays mounted and has no auth guard, the screen re-renders with user=null (showing 'S' avatar fallback) but the user is stuck. Fix: add a guard `if (!token) return <Redirect href='/login' />;` at the top of app/lobby.tsx and app/verify.tsx, or call `router.replace('/login')` inside signOut() after clearing state.
